title: Ripple Guard - A tower defense game
author: darklower

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/darklower please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: darklower
comments.body:
I made this with quite a bit of help from AI, so I thought I'd share how it came together.

* **Visuals and sounds:** Claude generated all the visuals directly in Canvas and created the sound effects using Python. No stock assets.
* **Design:** I used AI to research things like UX, level design, and tutorials, then applied what made sense for the game.
* **Playtesting:** The name Restroom Arcade isn't random. I tested the game on my phone, one thumb, a few minutes at a time, usually in the restroom. If something wasn't fun, I changed it or cut it.
* **Gameplay:** Towers send out waves instead of bullets. When two crests overlap, they deal up to 4x damage. When a crest meets a trough, they cancel out. So tower placement really matters.

It's built with vanilla JS and Canvas, no game engine, and runs on both desktop and mobile.

Would love to hear what you think, especially whether the wave mechanic feels intuitive!
